question: _______ demand for money arises mainly due to the uncertainty of future receipts and expenses.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Precautionary.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• People hold money in cash for three motives: (i)** Transactions motive**, (ii)** Precautionary motive**, and (iii) **Speculative motive.**
 
• **Precautionary Motive:**
 
 
• **​**People often demand money as a precaution against an uncertain future.
 
• Unexpected expenses, such as medical or car repair bills, often require immediate payment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Transactions Motive**

 
• Demanding money arises from the fact that most** transactions involve an exchange of money. **
 
• The** total number of transactions** made in an economy tends to increase over time as income rises.
 
• As income or GDP rises,** the transaction demand for money also rises.**

**Speculative Motive**

 
• Demanding money arises in situations where** holding money is perceived to be less risky than the alternative of lending the money or investing it in some other asset.**
 
• The demand for an asset depends on **both its rate of return and its opportunity cost.**
 
• Money holdings provide** no rate of return and often depreciate in value due to inflation.**
 
• The opportunity cost of holding money is the** interest rate that can be earned by lending or investing one's money holdings.**
